name: hud_ui_net_exit_panel_destructor
description: HudUiNetExitPanel::~HudUiNetExitPanel destroys the exit and resume widgets before the HudUiBackground base.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja exposes MSVC EH state bookkeeping for this destructor; the functional source contract is the member/base destruction order.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x41beb0 validates HudUiZrdWidget::DestructorCore on exitWidget, then resumeWidget, followed by HudUiBackground::Destructor on the panel base.
The native smoke patches HudUiZrdWidget::DestructorCore and HudUiBackground::Destructor, calls HudUiNetExitPanel::Destructor, and verifies exit-widget, resume-widget, background destruction order.
